newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Shinhan asked to toughen credit analysis.
newsitem.headline: Shinhan asked to toughen credit analysis.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea has asked Shinhan Bank to strengthen its credit analysis, the BOK said in an annual inspection released on Friday.
It said Shinhan needed to be more careful in screening companies and extending loans.
Shinhan's total assets increased to 35.0 trillion won by the end of January, compared with 27.9 trillion a year earlier.
The bank's weighted bad loan ratio dropped to 1.22 percent at the end of 1996 against 1.36 percent a year ago. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
